name: ScroBot
description: Macro bot plus 30+ options: Jump Hack, No Clip, Speedhack, Hitboxes, Low Detail Mode 2, FPS Boost, labels and more. Press Tab on PC, or tap Scro in the pause menu.

open-menu.name: Open Menu (PC)
open-menu.description: Shows or hides the mod panels.

ui-color.name: Menu Color
ui-color.description: Tint of the menu panel. White keeps the normal Geometry Dash look.

ui-accent.name: Accent Color
ui-accent.description: Color of values and headings in the menu.

ui-font.name: Menu Font
ui-font.description: Font used by the menu and the in-level labels.
